variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
